profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineering Manager
profile.summary:
Professional software engineer with over 10 years of experience in software development.  Expertise in  C/C++, Java and python  software development, software test and software debugging. Demonstrated ability in taking a leadership role coordinating team and projects.  Well versed in cross-cultural communications and the ability to work cross-functionally both locally and globally.  

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS
		
Programming Languages:
C, C++,  JAVA, Python, PERL,  Visual Basic, Assembly, Verilog, Spring Framework


Tools:
Eclipse, JTAG/Trace 32, QRCT, QPST, QXDM, Rational Robot/Clearcase/Clearquest, Git, REPO,  SVN, MS Office, Lotus Notes, JIRA

Environments:
ARM, Power PC, VMware, KVM,
Microsoft Windows XP/7/8 
Linux , Solaris,  Android

Areas of Expertise:
Software development & debug, embedded platform bring-up & customization, device drivers, software testing & automation, Industrialization Software

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Expanded Rest API functionality in Firepower management software extending Java frontend and PERL backend with JSON payload.
-	Developed Google Cloud container based Snort event handler solution including Golang based Kubernetes pod/service metadata collector and C++ based UDP plugin for exporting events to cloud sinks such as Vector.
-	Adapted containerized Snort with VPP dataplane to Kubernetes pod and enhanced Golang based gRPC management interface.
-	Adapted ASA firewall and Firepower nextgen firewall, intrusion prevention, and management devices to run in virtual machines in cloud environments such as VMWARE, KVM, AWS EC2, AZURE.   Efforts included Linux OS, driver, and bootloader customization, Day0 support, deployment scripts, and general software debug in C and Perl. 
-	Worked on a tiger team to improve firewall and management software upgrade functionality and stability.
-	Collaborated with remote teams to setup performance test beds for the KVM virtual firewall utilizing Breakingpoint and TeraVM.  Test beds were used to debug performance related bugs and establish linux tuning steps for KVM based Firewalls.
-	All Development followed Agile methodology with code management in Git or Perforce.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed PowerPC based embedded linux platform for an ethernet over copper card
-	Brought up U-Boot and Linux running on a Freescale P1010 processor with NAND, NOR, DDR3, FPGA,  and SERDES based Ethernet.
-	Intergrated toolchain into the Overture build system.
-	Ported Overture dual linux boot process and Overture applications to the card.
-	Debugged a number of complex platform issues including local bus conflict, NAND timing, and intermittent ethernet communication issues.
-	developed ECC support for the out of band area of the nand flash.
 Developed a bandwidth control application which utilized a Software Defined Network Controller.
-	The application was built using the Spring MVC for the web interface, Hibernate for persistence, and Rest to communicate with the Controller.
-	Spring Security and SSL were used to secure traffic and manage user authentication.
-	Spring Web Services was intergrated for a future SOAP northbound interface.
Developed a Java based Network Management System using the WebNMS framework.
-	Migrated the NMS codebase to the latest WebNMS framework version and created MYSQL database migration scripts. 
-	Added support to the NMS for managing 4 new products, as well as new features including performance management, trap forwarding and licensing tool.
-	Worked closely with a remote contract site in Eastern Europe to complete later phases of development.
-	Completed design documentation and schedule.
-	Managed code in SVN and bugs in JIRA.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Planned and lead the development of a Python based manufacturing test suite for gateway hardware.  The test suite included functionality for flashing, writing customization data, testing hardware such as Zigbee, Homeplug and modem, and uploading configuration information and test results to databases.
-	Developed manufacturing software to test Zigbee, Homeplug, and relay functionality of Device Controllers as well as calibrate the onboard MSP430 metrology chip against a standard.
-	Developed a linux driver and program to monitor power outages, send notification, and shut down the Gateway.
-	Debugged metrology issues with MSP430 on Device Controller.
-	Performed official builds and releases for Device Controller software.
-	Developed a boot loader for the Device Controller to handle OTA upgrades from Zigbee.
-	Point of contact for software issues seen at the contract manufacturer.
-	Upgraded R915 software to new PIC microprocessor.
-	Developed linux based self test and configuration bash scripts for gateway.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Planned and developed embedded test software solutions in C/C++ for Qualcomm and Ericsson based mobile phone projects.  Development activities included writing/modifying drivers, customizing operating systems, and writing test commands  for hardware including BT, Wifi, GPS, Display, Camera, Illumination, TVout, Sensors and GPIO control.

- Debugged software issues using tools such as JTAG and QXDM to improve software stability, factory yield and test time.

- Coordinated a team of three software engineers and up to five simultaneous embedded test software projects ensuring timely embedded test software deliveries.

- Provided remote and onsite factory support in Malaysia and China for prototype builds and high volume production.

- Worked closely with counterpart teams at remote sites in Sweden, Japan, and China to share work and expertise.

positions.title: Software COOP
positions.description:
- Setup Testquest Validor for automation testing and wrote C based automation scripts to test Bios.
- Automated the testing of Access Connections, CSS and FFE using Rational Robot.
- Wrote a set of API’s on top of Rational Robot to allow for easier and more efficient use.
- Setup a RAID server for the automation team which included CVS to manage all of the team’s code.
- Configured and tested client and server components of Websphere Everyplace Connection Manager software on Linux, AIX and Solaris.
- Updated and wrote scripts for inventory software used by the department.
